# Daily Math Puzzle

> Daily Math Puzzle (dailymathpuzzle.com) is a free daily math problem site for students and teachers: a new puzzle every day with a step-by-step solution, real entrance-exam questions (Gaokao, Oxford MAT, JEE Advanced, EBAU), a smart blackboard that reads handwriting, plots, solves and does geometry, and formula cheat sheets. In English, French, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

## Site

- [Today's puzzle and the blackboard](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/)
- [All puzzles](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/list.html)
- [Cheat sheets](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/cheatsheets.html): math formulas and theorems with step-by-step explanations on the blackboard
- [Formula compendium](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/formulas/): printable static pages of every formula and theorem by topic, in five languages
- [Sitemap](https://dailymathpuzzle.com/sitemap.xml)
